title: Caramelised Onion, Fennel and White Bean Calzone with Lemon
changes_from_base: A lemony mashed white bean layer and a slowly cooked mix of onion, fennel and fennel seed replace the cheese filling, so the single large calzone has no cheese at all.
summary: A single large pastry parcel of sweet caramelised onion and fennel paired with lemony white bean purée.

ingredients.item: large white onion, halved and thinly sliced
fine sea salt or table salt
cooked white beans (tinned and drained, or home-cooked)
fine sea salt or table salt
pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature
olive oil, for brushing and the tray
lemon, cut into wedges, to serve

steps.title: Prep fennel
steps.text: Trim off the fennel stalks, chop 2 tbsp of the feathery fronds and keep the remainder for another dish, halve the bulb lengthways, scoop out the tough core and slice the flesh into thin slivers.

steps.title: Caramelise
steps.text: Heat the large frying pan over medium-high heat, add 3 tbsp of the olive oil, the sliced fennel, the sliced white onion and the fennel seeds, and cook for about 25 min, stirring from time to time, until both vegetables are very soft and a deep golden colour, then season with the salt and black pepper.

steps.title: Mash beans
steps.text: In a small bowl, crush the drained white beans with a fork or potato masher along with 2 tbsp of olive oil, the finely grated lemon zest and the remaining salt and black pepper until you have a chunky purée.

steps.title: Heat oven
steps.text: Set the oven to 260 °C and lightly brush the baking tray with a little olive oil.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: On a lightly floured work surface, stretch or roll the pizza dough out to a 30 cm round.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread the bean mash over one half of the round leaving a 1 cm border, pile the caramelised fennel and onion on top and scatter the chopped fennel fronds over everything.

steps.title: Seal
steps.text: Wet the exposed edges of the dough with water, fold over to enclose the filling, press the edges firmly together to seal completely.

steps.title: Transfer
steps.text: Lift the sealed calzone onto the oiled baking tray, brush the top with a little olive oil and sprinkle with flaky sea salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake for 15–20 min until the pastry is golden and feels firm when lightly pressed, leave to cool for 5 min before serving with lemon wedges on the side.

tips: Cook the fennel and onion slowly so they soften completely and caramelise rather than brown too quickly on the outside.
Mash the beans until chunky rather than smooth so you still have some texture and don't end up with a paste.
Serve alongside fresh lemon wedges so each person can squeeze over a bit of brightness to balance the sweet vegetables.
storage: Serve warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
